turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
You reread them this morning, a week after you entered the zero. Decided first, read second. What do they show, specifically, and who decided?
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
Leave my evenings out of it, Hale. That's a compliment, not a document. What do those three essays show that you can put in front of me?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Then why does he have a zero? I'm not here for kind words about my parenting. Who decided, on what basis, and is there anything on his record right now?
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
It became a fight when the zero went in before anyone called me. Don't manage me, Hale. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal when we're done.
